Sneha Iyer | Chennai | sneha.iyer@example.com | +91 94440 55621

EDUCATION
B.Sc Computer Science, Madras Christian College, Chennai, 2023 - 2026, CGPA 8.1/10

INTERNSHIPS
Application Support Intern, Coromandel FinServ Technologies, Chennai (Dec 2025 - Feb 2026, 10 weeks)
- Supported the L1 team on user issues with the internal loan origination application.
- Logged, updated and closed user tickets in ServiceNow within agreed SLAs.
- Wrote SQL queries to check failed transaction records in the loan database.
- Used Linux commands like grep and tail to trace errors in application server logs.
- Analysed recurring login failures and traced them to a wrong session timeout setting.

PROJECTS
- Log Cleaner: wrote a bash script to compress and archive application log files older than 7 days.
- Hostel Complaint Tracker: built a small PHP and MySQL web app for students to raise and track complaints.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
Operating Systems, Database Management Systems, Computer Networks
ITIL 4 Foundation (self-study, exam scheduled)

SKILLS
SQL, MySQL, Linux, Bash, ServiceNow, Incident management, Java (basics), MS Excel

ACTIVITIES
Presented the weekly ticket summary to the support lead during the internship.
Volunteer, college NSS unit.
